name: ogbg_molpcba_exact_reference_tail
notes: Reconstruction configuration; no original trained weights or unreleased pool IDs are claimed.
The generic exact-reference-tail backend performs full continuation checks and has different compute costs from the native arxiv tube backend.

The paper names four molecular families but omits their full architecture and the molecular loss-regression tolerance. This main bond-aware GIN uses five layers, width 128 and mean pooling. zeta=0.0016 nats is an explicit chosen value, not a recovered Table-16 value. Missing assays are masked in fitting and reporting. Pooled episodic AP and custom reserved-holdout results must not be labeled full official OGB test performance.
Full: 512 calibration calls per configured depth per member, 512 selection calls per member, and 2048 final audit calls; smoke uses explicitly synthetic fixtures.
